labels.rationale: Usage question: Rich already provides Text.from_markup(...).plain to get text without markup tags.

body:
Rich renders markup into styled `Text`, and the plain string without the tags is available from `Text.from_markup(...).plain`. To filter on the text your menu items would display, match against that value instead of the raw markup string. The markup syntax is described in [docs/source/markup.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst).

For general questions like this, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
